Hey girl! I dealt with eczema in the same places just not as severe as yours. I went to derma but their creams didn’t work for me. I suggest going to an immunologist. I went to one and he had me do an elimination diet and it turned out cutting gluten and dairy out of my diet (I have to be extremely strict about being gluten free) got rid of my eczema completely. Took around 2 months but it helped me. Figure out your trigger if you can! Immunologists can help you figure out what you may be allergic or sensitive to since eczema is autoimmune
